title: Procurement Signal Orchestra and Model Compatibility Canvass
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Synthesize continuous market signals into a prioritized orchestration for procurement readiness. Build a repeatable canvass that maps model variants to deployment constraints (latency, quantization, hardware affinity), legal/licensing considerations, and commercial triggers for reserved capacity. Output will be a living artifact used by PM, procurement, and platform engineering to make rapid fallback and purchase decisions.
deliverables: Canonical Model Compatibility Canvass (spreadsheet + brief) linking model variants to hardware & quantization profiles
Procurement Signal Playbook: event definitions that trigger procurement actions (reserve, negotiate, fallback) and associated thresholds
Dashboard spec for lightweight tracking of availability, price volatility, and latency delta across regions
Hand-off package for Solutions Eng / Procurement with top-5 fallback families and estimated commit costs
acceptance_criteria: Canvass covers >= 12 high-priority model families we currently track or plan to onboard
Playbook defines at least 4 procurement triggers with clear thresholds and responsible owners
Dashboard spec has wireframe + required telemetry schema and an initial data ingest plan
Procurement / Platform engineering review and sign-off on hand-off package
risks: Signal noise leading to false-positive procurement actions
Incomplete hardware affinity data for some emerging open models
Legal/licensing edge cases that require procurement/legal escalation
Cross-team alignment overhead — platform and procurement cycles may differ
